matches.rationale: No finding addresses the specific (PI)/(DI) inequality-vs-equality constraint inconsistency or the resulting confusion between Algorithm 1's primal/dual updates in Section 4.1; Finding 1 targets Algorithm 2's slack update (4.2), Finding 5 targets gamma's declared domain, and Finding 6 targets equation (2) in Section 3 — none implicate the same (PI)/(DI)/Algorithm 1 locus.

Findings 2 and 4 both formally show that Assumption 1 as stated is insufficient to establish Theorem 4.1's bound (via counterexamples exposing a missing operator-norm hypothesis), which is the same core defect GT2 describes — a weakened/underspecified Assumption 1 that leaves Theorems 4.1/4.2 unsupported or vacuous — even though the precise missing clause differs, satisfying R2's polarity tolerance.
